name: list_generative_plugins
description: Lists the generative plugins in the authenticated user's account library, including Figma's first-party plugins. Returns each plugin's id, name, description, and owner (plus a nextCursor when more pages exist). Owner is the authenticated user's email for their plugins, or a public publisher handle otherwise. Use the id with get_generative_plugin to read a plugin's source. Generative plugins are runnable tools that modify the canvas, distinct from shader effects and shader fills.

cursor.description: Pagination cursor returned as nextCursor by a previous call. Omit to fetch the first page.
